Free · In-App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Migo is a language playground built for kids aged 3 and up. Your child taps colorful cards, hears native speakers say each word, and plays games that make new languages feel like fun, not homework. WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN Migo teaches real, everyday vocabulary across five categories: Animals, Things, Food, Numbers, and more. Every word appears in two languages at once, so your child absorbs both their home language and a new one naturally. Choose from English, Spanish, and French, with many more languages on the way. No app update needed when new languages arrive. Just download and play. THREE WAYS TO PLAY Vocabulary Cards Tap any card to see a beautiful kawaii illustration, read the word in both languages, and hear it spoken by a native speaker. Over 100 words to discover. Where Is? A playful guessing game that asks your child to find the right picture. It reinforces vocabulary through repetition without feeling repetitive. Puzzles Gorgeous jigsaw puzzles with multiple difficulty levels (4, 6, or 12 pieces) and three visual styles. Perfect for building focus while having fun. WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET Download a language pack once and Migo works everywhere: planes, road trips, waiting rooms, anywhere your child needs something wonderful to do. # A vocabulary app for every child learning to talk, ages 0–6

From first word to first thousand — from Klingon to Croatian, anywhere on Earth

Every child on Earth learns their first words. EveryLingo helps with that — 720+ real words with audio, built into calm games, in 142 language options. Don’t like how a word sounds for your dialect, or the photo that comes with it? Swap in your own voice, and any image from your real life — your dog, a family member, your child’s favourite toy. We don’t have the language you want to pass on? Add it yourself — any language ever spoken or invented. The possibilities for customising are endless.

 🌱 Build first words 🌍 Bilingual & multilingual growth 🎈 Playful but calm games 🎙️ Customise any word or create new
